name: page-header
summary: The list/detail PAGE HEADER at the top of a page: an optional back button OR a section menu-toggle + the title (--primary-alt, weight 500, 18px) + an optional count pill on the left, and right-side actions (search / export / primary Add) via the default slot, over a --border-color bottom rule. Split from the product’s Toolbars family. Feature-complete variants: default · with-count · back · menu-toggle (module SECTION header, shows/hides obs-side-menu) · with-subtitle · with-breadcrumb · detail-meta (RUM/APM span-detail strip) · monitor-detail · title-only · no-divider. NOT the strip above a list/table (that is obs-toolbar), NOT between-page navigation (obs-sidebar / obs-breadcrumbs), and NOT the global app top-bar (obs-app-header).

variants.name: default
variants.what: title + right-side actions over a bottom rule (the list-page top bar)

variants.name: with-count
variants.what: a count pill next to the title (collection size)

variants.name: back
variants.what: a leading back chevron in a full-height left gutter, centred on the title line (emits `back`)

variants.name: menu-toggle
variants.what: the SECTION header — a circular side-menu toggle (26px) + a vertical separator + a centred leading icon; fires `menutoggle` {open} and flips its chevron ‹/› via `menu-open` (Settings & any module sub-nav). NOT a back button.

variants.name: with-subtitle
variants.what: title + a secondary muted line under it (detail / drill-down / drawer headers)

variants.name: with-breadcrumb
variants.what: a location trail slot ABOVE the header row (drop obs-breadcrumbs)

variants.name: detail-meta
variants.what: accent stripe + title + a wrapping " | "-separated metadata strip (RUM/APM Session/Action/Resource span-detail header); meta fields can carry a status dot

variants.name: monitor-detail
variants.what: the inventory monitor-detail composition — breadcrumb + title + a status badge (obs-tag) + a type/meta strip + right-side icon actions (refresh / topology / full-screen)

variants.name: title-only
variants.what: the minimal header — title + a single primary action, no count/divider extras

variants.name: no-divider
variants.what: a MODIFIER that drops the bottom rule (header on a surface that already has an edge — a card/panel)

heading.note: the page title (uses `heading`, not `title`, so it doesn’t set a native tooltip). --primary-alt, weight 500, 18px, line-height 1.5, ellipsised.

count.note: optional count pill shown next to the title (--timerange-background-color / --timerange-text-color).

back.note: show the leading back chevron button; clicking it emits `back`. (Or provide a `back` slot for a custom control.)

no-divider.note: remove the bottom rule; default shows a 1px --border-color divider (matching the 54× render).

subtitle.note: optional secondary muted line under the title (--neutral-theme-color) — the detail/drill-down/drawer header pattern (title + subtitle).

meta.note: detail-header ATTRIBUTE STRIP — a JSON array of {label?,value,icon?,status?}, rendered as a wrapping " | "-separated key:value row below the title (the RUM/APM Session/Action/Resource span-detail header). icon → obs-icon; status → obs-severity dot; label muted (--neutral-theme-color); value --page-text-color.

accent.note: left accent stripe (3px) coloured by a severity level (up/critical/warning/major/clear/down → --severity-<level>) or a colour token (--x / #hex). Marks the entity type/severity on a detail header. Accepts a severity level (maps to --severity-<level>), a colour token (--x), or a raw colour.

menu-toggle.note: render the SECTION-header cluster — a CIRCULAR toggle button (26px) + a vertical separator before the title. Shows/hides the current module’s obs-side-menu; fires `menutoggle` {open}. Pair with a `before`-slot module glyph. Not a back button.

menu-open.note: the side-menu’s open state — flips the toggle chevron (open → ‹ collapse · closed → › expand) and drives aria-expanded / the aria-label. Bind it to your own menu state.

events.back: () — the back button was clicked (wire it to your router.back() / navigation).
events.menutoggle: detail = { open } — the NEW side-menu state after the circular toggle is clicked. Wire it to show/hide the module's obs-side-menu.

slots.default: the right-side actions — compose obs-input (search), obs-button (primary Add), icon buttons, etc.
slots.back: a custom leading control, replacing the default back chevron.
slots.title: extra content after the title — a status badge (obs-severity / obs-tag), e.g. the monitor detail "Up".
slots.breadcrumb: a breadcrumb trail ABOVE the header row (drop obs-breadcrumbs here); the slot is invisible when empty.
slots.before: content immediately BEFORE the title (a monitor-type icon / avatar).

decisionFlow: Title + primary actions at the TOP of a page (list or detail)? -> obs-page-header.

A MODULE section bar that shows/hides a left sub-nav (Settings, and any module with an obs-side-menu)? -> set menu-toggle + wire @menutoggle to show/hide the side-menu; put the module glyph in the `before` slot. This is NOT a back button.
A detail/nested page drilled into from a list that needs a way back? -> set back (emits `back`; wire to router.back()). Use back OR menu-toggle, not both.
A secondary line under the title (type / id / last-run)? -> add subtitle="…". A location trail above it? -> the breadcrumb slot (obs-breadcrumbs).
An entity/span DETAIL header with a row of attribute fields (Session/Action/Resource, monitor detail)? -> add accent="<severity>" + meta=[{label,value,icon?,status?}] (the metadata strip).
A collection whose size matters? -> add count="N" (the count pill).
Header sitting on a card/panel that already has an edge? -> add no-divider.
A search / filter / bulk-action strip sitting ABOVE a list or table? -> obs-toolbar (not page-header).
The GLOBAL app top bar (logo / search / notifications / user)? -> obs-app-header (a separate archetype).
Navigating BETWEEN pages/routes? -> obs-sidebar (primary nav) or obs-breadcrumbs (the trail).
Switching sibling views of the SAME page? -> obs-tabs.
A widget's own title + time-range + kebab? -> the widget-header toolbar variant (obs-toolbar).

default.useWhen: every list/detail page's top bar — the title and the page's primary actions (Add, export, search).
default.dontUse: for a control strip that belongs ABOVE a table -> obs-toolbar.
default.example: Monitors list: title + count + Search + Export + Add Monitor.

with-count.useWhen: the title names a collection whose size matters (N monitors / alerts).

back.useWhen: a detail/nested page the user drills into from a list — give them a way back (emits `back`; wire to router.back()).
back.dontUse: on a top-level list page reachable from the nav (no back target); and never together with menu-toggle.
back.example: Monitor detail -> back to the Monitors list.

menu-toggle.useWhen: a MODULE section header whose page hosts a left sub-nav (obs-side-menu) — the circular toggle shows/hides that menu; put the module glyph (e.g. cog) in the `before` slot. Bind :menu-open to your menu state so the chevron reads ‹ (collapse) when open / › (expand) when closed.
menu-toggle.dontUse: as a back button (it does NOT navigate) or on a page with no side-menu to toggle; not together with back.
menu-toggle.example: Settings: <obs-page-header heading="Settings" menu-toggle :menu-open="open" @menutoggle="open = $event.detail.open"><obs-icon slot="before" name="cog" size="20"></obs-icon></obs-page-header>.
menu-toggle.must: Wire @menutoggle to actually show/hide the obs-side-menu; keep :menu-open in sync so the chevron direction matches reality.

with-subtitle.useWhen: a detail / drill-down / drawer header where a secondary line adds context (type, id, last-run).
with-subtitle.example: AlmaLinux 9 (CIS) / "Compliance benchmark · 214 rules · last run 2h ago" (the compliance drill-down).

with-breadcrumb.useWhen: a nested page that benefits from a location trail above the title.
with-breadcrumb.example: Inventory / Monitors / web-server-01 (drop obs-breadcrumbs in the breadcrumb slot).

detail-meta.useWhen: an entity/span detail header (RUM Session/Action/Resource, APM trace) that needs a row of attribute key:value fields under the title, optionally with an accent stripe and status dots.
detail-meta.dontUse: a simple list/detail page (use subtitle or nothing).

monitor-detail.useWhen: the inventory monitor-detail top header — a breadcrumb + title + a live status badge (obs-tag) + a type/meta strip, with icon actions (refresh / topology / full-screen) in the actions slot.
monitor-detail.dontUse: a generic detail page (compose only the pieces you need — subtitle or meta).
monitor-detail.example: ubuntu-linux2 (motadata-freetier): breadcrumb + Up badge + Type/Environment/Group meta + refresh/topology/full-screen icon buttons.
monitor-detail.must: The metric rings/gauges some monitor headers show are SEPARATE chart/gauge components composed into the actions slot — not part of page-header.

title-only.useWhen: a minimal header — a title plus one primary action, nothing else.
title-only.dontUse: when the page needs a count, search, or multiple actions (use default).
title-only.example: Alert Policies + a single "Create Policy" primary button.

no-divider.useWhen: the header sits on a card/panel that already provides a bottom edge.
no-divider.dontUse: as the default page top bar (keep the divider).
no-divider.example: a header inside a bordered settings card — no-divider.

padding.useWhen: --page-header-padding controls the CONTENT inset only (default 8px all sides). The bottom divider always spans EDGE TO EDGE (full width) regardless of the padding.
padding.dontUse: the page content area already applies padding — then set --page-header-padding: 0 to avoid double inset.
padding.example: style="--page-header-padding: 0" removes the content inset; a larger value (e.g. 16px 24px) makes a roomier header. The divider stays full-width either way.

a11y.summary: The title is an <h4> heading — one page-header per view. The back control is a real <button aria-label="Back"> that fires `back` on click/Enter/Space. The menu-toggle is a real <button> with aria-expanded reflecting :menu-open and an aria-label that flips between "Hide menu" (open) and "Show menu" (closed); its chevron is decorative (aria-hidden). Actions in the default slot are the consumer’s own focusable controls (obs-button/obs-input) in DOM order after the title. The accent stripe, the leading `before` icon, and the meta field ICONS are decorative (aria-hidden); meta LABELS are real text ("Label: value") so screen readers read the attribute names. A status badge (obs-tag) carries its own accessible label. The circular toggle has a visible :focus-visible ring (--primary-alt).

issues.issue: The count pill ("128") is presented as plain text next to the title; if the count must be announced as a labelled figure, put it in the meta strip (label:"Monitors", value:"128") instead.

menu-toggle communicates state via aria-expanded + an aria-label swap, but the association to the side-menu it controls is implicit — add aria-controls="<side-menu id>" on the toggle when the module side-menu has a stable id.

knownIssues.issue: menu-toggle is STATELESS about the side-menu — it only fires `menutoggle` {open} and reflects `menu-open`. The consumer owns the actual show/hide of the obs-side-menu and must keep :menu-open in sync (the DS starter Settings page is the reference wiring).

The detail-header variants (subtitle · meta strip · accent · monitor-detail) are SOURCE-DERIVED — the product headers are store/data-bound with no Storybook story, so they are built from the source (rum-drill-down-header.vue / compliance-breadcrumb.vue) and verified against product screenshots, not the diff gate. The default list-header IS diff-gated (organisms-toolbars-examples--page-header, ✅ MATCH).

The inventory monitor-detail TOP header also shows metric rings/gauges and read-only pill groups on the right — those are separate components (a chart/gauge + obs-tag/obs-selected-pills) composed into the actions slot, not part of obs-page-header itself.

changelog: 2026-09-25 — (owner) FULL completeness pass now that every variant + the menu-toggle functionality is in. Section-header polish finalised: 18px chevron in a 26px circle, state-specific optical nudge (open ‹ → translateX(-1px), closed › → +1px), cog glyph 20px. Docs brought to decision-grade: variants[] now lists all 10 (added monitor-detail, title-only); a usageRules card for every variant (menu-toggle/monitor-detail/title-only added); decisionFlow routes the SECTION-header case (menu-toggle vs back vs sidebar) + title-only/count/no-divider; menu-toggle/menu-open props retyped to real booleans; a11y covers the toggle (aria-expanded + label swap + focus ring); tokensUsed adds the toggle surface/hover tokens; knownIssues notes the toggle is stateless (consumer wires the side-menu). Playground now reaches every variant (title-only + no-divider presets added).

2026-09-25 — (owner) SECTION-header polish (product match): heading is now 18px (was 16px); the menu-toggle CIRCLE shrank to 28×28 (was 32) with a 13px chevron (was 15) + a 1px optical-centre nudge (the chevron point juts left); the toggle · | · title cluster tightened (8px gap, 22px separator, no side margins). The variant is now surfaced in the DS showcase (playground preset + gallery: menu-open ‹ / menu-collapsed › + toggle/menu-open controls).

2026-09-25 — (owner) New MENU-TOGGLE variant + two fixes. (1) `menu-toggle` renders the product's CIRCULAR bordered chevron button + a vertical separator before the title, and fires `menutoggle` {open} to SHOW/HIDE the module's side-menu (the chevron flips ‹/› via `menu-open`); it is NOT a back button. (2) The leading `before`-slot icon (e.g. the Settings gear) now CENTERS on the title line (was top-aligned) — a simple header center-aligns its leading controls; a detail header (subtitle/meta) still top-aligns them.
2026-08-11 — Padding tightened to 8px on all four sides (owner). --page-header-padding default is now 8px; divider stays full-width.

2026-08-11 — Divider + padding (owner, ref #152/#153): the bottom divider now spans EDGE TO EDGE (moved to the full-width .wrap; it was inset by the content padding). Reduced the default content inset to a compact 10px 16px (was 16px 20px 0). --page-header-padding now controls the CONTENT inset only; the divider is always full-width.

2026-08-06 — Padding fix (owner): the header now carries its own left/right/top inset (var(--page-header-padding, 16px 20px 0)) instead of padding: 8px 0. The product page-header leans on the page content area (@padding-lg) for that inset, so dropped straight into a card it rendered flush to the edge. Override --page-header-padding: 0 when the surrounding page already pads.

changelog.change: Completeness pass: `accent` now declares its enum (the severity levels the playground dropdown offers — up/clear/warning/major/critical/down/maintenance — while still accepting a colour token or raw colour). Confirmed every variant (default, back, with-count, no-divider, with-subtitle, with-breadcrumb, detail-meta, monitor-detail) is reachable from the playground presets + toggles.

Completeness pass: accent control is now a severity DROPDOWN (up/clear/warning/major/critical/down/maintenance) not open text; added rich playground presets (list · detail+subtitle+back · RUM meta strip · status dots · monitor detail) + a monitor-detail gallery example (breadcrumb + status badge via obs-tag + meta + icon actions, #80); added usedIn ("Where it’s used"), expanded Accessibility, and Known issues (source-derived detail variants; metric rings out of scope).
Back button now centres on the TITLE line (top-aligned left column, back height = title line box) — it sits on the heading line while subtitle + meta stay left-aligned under the heading.
Layout: the back button is now a full-height LEFT GUTTER; title + subtitle + meta strip form a left-aligned column beside it (subtitle/meta line up under the heading, no longer indented under back).

Fixes: export/secondary buttons use variant=default (bordered) instead of neutral-lighter (which read as disabled); the icon button uses squared (keeps the 4px radius) not square (radius 0); the back button now sits in the title row so it is vertically centred with the title, not the whole block.

Added the common DETAIL-HEADER variant — a meta attribute strip (JSON [{label,value,icon?,status?}] → a wrapping " | "-separated key:value row, reusing obs-icon + obs-severity dot) and an accent stripe (severity/colour), source-derived from the RUM/APM span-detail header (rum-drill-down-header.vue). Default layout unchanged (diff stays ✅). Covers the Session/Action/Resource + monitor-detail headers.

Added subtitle (detail/drill-down/drawer header pattern — sourced from compliance-breadcrumb + drawer-header) and a breadcrumb slot + before slot. Default gallery now includes the export/download icon action (obs-button[square], reused). App header is documented as a separate archetype, not a page-header variant.

Added obs-page-header element — render-faithful page header (title + optional back + count pill + right-side actions slot + bottom divider), split from the product Toolbars family (FlotoPageHeader, 54×). diff.mjs ✅ MATCH (light+dark); reuses obs-icon (back) and composes obs-button/obs-input in the actions slot. 2nd of the Structure & Navigation set.

usedIn: The top bar of every list page — Monitors / Alerts / Alert Policies / Reports (title + count + search + primary Add). FlotoPageHeader, 54× across ~40 files.
Module SECTION headers — Settings and any module page with a left sub-nav: the circular menu-toggle + separator + module glyph + heading (obs-side-menu shown/hidden below).
Detail / nested pages — a back button + title (+ subtitle) + record actions (Edit / Export / Re-run).
Entity / span DETAIL headers — the RUM/APM Session · Action · Resource drill-downs and the inventory Monitor detail: accent stripe + title + a status badge + a " | "-separated metadata strip.
Inside a drawer/panel (with subtitle or a meta strip) — the drawer supplies its own close; page-header supplies the title + meta.
do: Use as the top bar of a list/detail page — title + count + the page’s primary actions (Add / export / search).
Add back (a left gutter, centred on the title) for a nested/detail page drilled into from a list.
Use menu-toggle for a module SECTION header that shows/hides a left sub-nav (Settings); wire @menutoggle to the obs-side-menu and keep :menu-open in sync; put the module glyph in the `before` slot.
Use a subtitle, or an accent + meta strip, for entity/detail headers (RUM/APM span detail, monitor detail); a breadcrumb slot for a trail.
Compose the actions from DS elements — obs-input (search), obs-button (Add / bordered secondary / [squared] icon).
dont: Don’t treat menu-toggle as a back button — it toggles a side-menu, it does not navigate; and don’t combine it with back.
Don’t use for a search/filter/bulk-action strip above a list or table — that is obs-toolbar.
Don’t use for the global app top bar (logo / notifications / user) — that is obs-app-header.
Don’t use for between-page navigation — obs-sidebar (primary) / obs-breadcrumbs (trail).
Don’t use `title` as the heading attribute (it sets a native tooltip) — use `heading`.
